Hi keshab
Please see the code of Dolphin example provided in R package DSM helpfile. The projection should be same for your transect(segment coordinates) and study area.

Dear Sir,
Thank you very much for your kind suggestion. My all data sets are in WGS1984, I am unable to plot the shape file in this current format. Should I use different projection ? Or is there anything wrong with the codes I am using for it? If anyone can help me in this would be very thankful to you.
The codes I used,
# maps
library(maps)
set.seed(11123)
library(maptools)
library(rgdal)
library(plyr)
survey.area<-readShapeSpatial("survey_area")
lon0 <- 70.6628
lat0 <- 21.1798
sa.tmp <- latlong2km(survey.area$longitude, survey.area$latitude, lon0 = lon0,lat0 = lat0)
survey.area <- data.frame(x = 1000 * sa.tmp$km.e, y = 1000 * sa.tmp$km.n)
rm(sa.tmp)
##to overlay transects with shapefile
gg.opts <- theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),panel.background = element_blank())
p <- qplot(data = survey.area, x = x, y = y, geom = "polygon",fill = I("lightblue"), ylab = "y", xlab = "x", alpha = I(0.7))
p <- p + coord_equal()
p <- p + gg.opts
p <- p + geom_line(aes(x, y, group = Transect.Label), data = segdata)
print(p)
 
Thanking you.
 
 
With regards
Keshab
